say:1:1026231001:1.text: I heard you calling me in my dream, Merlin... Thank you for restoring everything.
say:1:1026231001:1.source_cn: 我在梦中听到了你的呼唤，梅林……谢谢你复原了我的梦境。
say:1:1026231001:1.male: I heard you calling me in my dream, Merlin... Thank you for restoring everything.
say:1:1026231001:1.female: I heard you calling me in my dream, Merlin... Thank you for restoring everything.

say:2:1026231002:1.text: Avalon has blossomed almost overnight, and most of the Hypofiends have disappeared. You truly are a miracle worker.
say:2:1026231002:1.source_cn: 唔，一眨眼之间，阿瓦隆已经欣欣向荣，连魔物也消失了大半...
say:2:1026231002:1.male: Avalon has blossomed almost overnight, and most of the Hypofiends have disappeared. You truly are a miracle worker.
say:2:1026231002:1.female: Avalon has blossomed almost overnight, and most of the Hypofiends have disappeared. You truly are a miracle worker.

say:3:1026231003:1.text: Seeing you do all of this, I must do my part as well, for everyone's sake.
say:3:1026231003:1.source_cn: 看到你这么努力的样子，我也要为大家贡献出自己的一份力量。
say:3:1026231003:1.male: Seeing you do all of this, I must do my part as well, for everyone's sake.
say:3:1026231003:1.female: Seeing you do all of this, I must do my part as well, for everyone's sake.

say:4:1026231004:1.text: I will call the <style="highlight">Dream Pavilion</style> to Avalon and, through the power of dreams, <style="highlight">shower this land with blessings</style>. This place will flourish like never before.

say:5:1026231005:1.text: Be sure to visit me at the Dream Pavilion each day. Otherwise, I might forget after I fall asleep...
say:5:1026231005:1.source_cn: 你要记得每天都来梦现亭找我哦，否则我睡着后有可能会忘记……
say:5:1026231005:1.male: Be sure to visit me at the Dream Pavilion each day. Otherwise, I might forget after I fall asleep...
say:5:1026231005:1.female: Be sure to visit me at the Dream Pavilion each day. Otherwise, I might forget after I fall asleep...

say:6:1026231006:1.text: May my power be of help to you and to Avalon, Merlin.
say:6:1026231006:1.source_cn: 希望我的力量能助你和阿瓦隆一臂之力……梅林。
say:6:1026231006:1.male: May my power be of help to you and to Avalon, Merlin.
say:6:1026231006:1.female: May my power be of help to you and to Avalon, Merlin.
